create.name: Alana Fairchild
create.bio:
Alana Fairchild is an Australian spiritual teacher, writer and singer best known for her oracle decks, which pair commissioned artwork with her own messages and practices for each card. She has written dozens of decks and a shelf of companion books and journals, among them Crystal Angels 444, Crystal Goddesses 888, Wisdom of Kuan Yin, Magic of Isis and Messages in the Numbers. Her work draws on the divine feminine across traditions, from Kuan Yin, Tara and Kali to Isis and Mary, and mixes mantra, sacred gesture, crystal work, ritual and devotional chant.

She teaches mostly through long online programmes and live gatherings. Kuan Yin Transmission and Saraswati Healing are energy practices she developed herself, and students who complete the in-depth training can become licensed practitioners of them; shorter immersions centre on Kali, Isis, Venus or the Madonna. In 2026 she took her Venus Empowerment event on a tour that includes Melbourne, Hamburg, California and Calgary. She has also recorded albums of guided meditation and chant, posts regular talks on her YouTube channel, and keeps a free online oracle on her website. She no longer gives private readings, preferring to put her time into courses, community and new projects. Her business is registered in New South Wales.

courses.title: Kuan Yin Transmission
courses.description: A self-paced online training over about sixteen weeks in the divine feminine energy practice she created, working with Kuan Yin, Isis, Mary, Tara and Kali through mudra, mantra and visualisation. It is the route to becoming a licensed practitioner of the method.

courses.title: Saraswati Healing
courses.description: Her longest online programme: invocation, ritual and heart and throat chakra practices with angels, ascended masters and goddesses, using her decks, books and music as tools. It now runs together with the intermediate Tantric Flow module.

courses.title: Venus Empowerment (online programme)
courses.description: A ten-week online journey released in stages every two weeks, built around the lineage she calls the Shamanic Bee, with teachings on animal guides, angelic ritual and energy practice. It follows on from her live Venus Empowerment events.

courses.title: Kali Oracle Immersion
courses.description: An open-level online course on the goddess Kali, approached through oracle work, ritual and devotion. Participants explore what the fierce mother figure means for their own path.

courses.title: Mysterium of the Madonna
courses.description: Six guided inner pilgrimages taken from home, each linking through ritual to a Marian holy site somewhere in the world. Led online by Alana.

courses.title: Isis 888 Festival
courses.description: An open online course devoted to the Egyptian goddess Isis, with ritual, guided journeys and teaching on her mysteries. Suitable for any level.

free_resources.title: Free online oracle reading
free_resources.description: A three-card reading on her website: pick one of her decks, hold a question in mind and choose cards to read their messages. No sign-up needed.
